_comment: Per-version field impact for cortex-platform-xdm-author, so a consumer can answer
'did version X change the MEANING of field F' in one step instead of reading prose.
Built for the cortex-content-pack-go-again phase 900 STEP ZERO precondition: a
migration check that measures a SECOND field against the still-installed old model
is only valid if the migration did not change that field. The distinction that makes
this worth having is mentioned_only -- four packs once 'touched xdm.event.type' in a
migration and all four hits were comment lines, so a grep over diffs stops the reader
while a positive 'meaning unchanged' lets them proceed.
ENTRIES ARE PER-VERSION DELTAS, each relative to the version below it. A consumer
crossing a RANGE takes the union of every entry in that range: going 1.8.1 -> 2.0.0
means reading 1.8.2 through 2.0.0, not 2.0.0 alone.
BUCKETS. Every xdm. path named in a version's changelog entry lands in exactly one,
which tests/test_field_impact.py enforces against CHANGELOG.md, so this file cannot
quietly fall behind and absence cannot be mistaken for an unrecorded change:
meaning_changed   - a rule that correctly assigned the field BEFORE is now wrong
about what it means. Do not compare values across this version.
mandatory_changed - the field's required-ness moved. Values still mean the same
thing; the POPULATION may change. Safe to compare, not to count.
banned            - the field must no longer be assigned at all.
mentioned_only    - named in the entry, with meaning, legality and required-ness all
unchanged. This is a POSITIVE statement of no impact, not a gap.
complete=true means every xdm. path in that version's changelog entry is classified
here. It does NOT claim the changelog itself is exhaustive: a meaning change the
entry never mentioned would be missed here too, and that is a changelog defect.

mentioned_only.note: Named while recording its two historical moves (1.6.1 and 1.9.0), and as the worked example of an exclusive --from. No change here.
Named while recording its 1.8.9 value-format change. No change here.
Named while recording that 1.7.0 moved it. No change here.
Named as the WORKED CASE for the registry's central distinction: two versions discuss it without moving it. This release does not touch it.
Named only in the account of the 1.8.14 entry's shorthand being written out in full. The 1.8.14 facts are unchanged.
Named as the deliberate counter-example -- mandatory at 1.8.23, not a meaning change. No change here.
CLASSIFY ONCE, DERIVE MANY: how the chain is CONSTRUCTED. Meaning, values and required-ness unchanged.
Same. Derived from one tmp_class rather than a parallel chain; the tag vocabulary is untouched.
Branch ORDER within the chain, and a reference example reordered. No value or meaning change.
Same. The two chains were made to agree on precedence; neither field's meaning moved.
RESTATES the 1.9.0 reversal for the major-version rationale. The change itself is 1.9.0's; crossing 1.9.x -> 2.0.0 alone does not move this field.
Restates 1.8.23's mandatory addition.
The bundle corrected its own bad advice (a bare concat() into a String (Array) field). The field was always an array; a rule written to the old advice was always broken.
Restates 1.8.14's conditional scoping, and a scaffolder defect that padded the leaves. No scope change here.
Documentation fix: EVENT_TAG is fully enumerated and mandatory, against a reference that said to omit it.
Appears only in the account of a FortiGate rule authored against 1.8.24 guidance while 1.9.0 had reversed it. This version is about ERR-034 and the backtick tokeniser.

meaning_changed.was: the authentication SERVICE NAME (as 1.6.1 wrongly established)
meaning_changed.now: the ROLE the system played in the flow -- IDP, SP or Universal -- decided PER EVENT TYPE
meaning_changed.migration: A rule correct under 1.6.1..1.8.24 writes a service name and is now wrong; WARN-042 flags it. Values are not comparable across this version. The protocol or mechanism that was being written there moves to xdm.auth.auth_method, xdm.network.application_protocol or xdm.logon.package_name.

mentioned_only.note: Named as a DESTINATION for content displaced from auth.service. Its own meaning is unchanged.
Same -- a destination, not a change.
Same -- a destination, not a change.
Named as where an access channel (CLI, GUI, API) belongs. Unchanged.
Stated that an access channel is BARRED from it because the closed list would be corrupted. A constraint restated, not a new one.
Mentioned in the authentication set; the mandatory addition is 1.8.23's.

mandatory_changed.detail: Becomes the fifteenth MANDATORY field on any record classified as authentication: the entity the principal authenticated TO. A rule correct before is now INCOMPLETE rather than wrong, so existing values remain comparable. It must NEVER be padded (WARN-055 flags a placeholder), and it is set IN ADDITION to the type-correct target field, never instead of it -- so xdm.target.host.hostname and xdm.target.application.name keep their mappings and asset correlation is unaffected.

mentioned_only.note: Appears in the CiscoIOSXR inversion account (764 SSH logins with the accessed router mapped here). No change to the field.
Keeps its mapping under the dual-mapping rule.
Keeps its mapping under the dual-mapping rule.
Contrasted as a field where an empty pad IS honest. Unchanged.
The cloud-only reading of this subtree is superseded for authentication events only.
Listed among the existing mandatory set.
ERR-031 consequence: there is no logout verb in OPERATION_TYPE, so leave the verb unset on a logout. A statement about the CONSTANT list, not about the field.
Named as where a logout is carried instead. Unchanged.
Discipline for companion-field advisories: name the ENTITY each field describes, since the target subtree is not one object per record. No field changed.

mandatory_changed.detail: Moved OUT of the unconditional 20-field network set into a conditional set, mandatory only where the event carries an HTTP layer. A rule that omitted it on a non-HTTP flow stops being flagged; one that mapped it stays correct. Values are comparable; the flagged population shrinks.
Same conditional set. All-or-nothing: a rule claiming an HTTP layer must complete the set.
Same conditional set. Padding it onto a router or SNMP record asserts a protocol the source never saw.

mentioned_only.note: The subtree is what a rule maps to DECLARE an HTTP layer. Unchanged.
Capture discipline -- terminate on CONTENT, not end-of-line, wherever the value will be COMPARED. Affects extraction quality, not the field's meaning.
Same capture discipline. A trailing space makes an exact-match correlation return zero rows.
Named as the canonical derivation, with <account>@localhost accepted for a device-local login. Guidance on how to FILL it; the field's meaning is unchanged.
Documented that the subtree has NO address field, so the natural mapping is rejected by ERR-020. A documentation of the schema, not a change to it.
The syslog HOSTNAME slot often holds an address, which is correct here but unreachable by address-based correlation.
Named as the workaround for the missing observer address, with the conflation that accepts.
Counter-example for the padding rule: any protocol name is a factual claim, so leave unset. Guidance.

meaning_changed.now: the application and event name as a PAIR
meaning_changed.migration: The VALUE FORMAT changes, so values are not comparable across this version and any correlation or constancy measurement keyed on the field must be re-taken. The reason for the change is that name and id each collide across applications, so a correlation keyed on either alone matches unrelated events.

mentioned_only.note: Receives the event id, which moved out of original_event_type's value. The field's own meaning is unchanged.
Command-I/O events routed to the process family, matching AAA command accounting. A routing rule, not a field change.
A companion check was designed and deliberately NOT shipped, because the detectable signal is the branch VALUE while the defect is in its CONDITION. Nothing changed.
The field-set diff step for a rule that REPLACES an existing one: enumerate the old rule's assignments and set-subtract the new one's. Generic, no specific field.
Never GATE it on a syslog facility, which sweeps unrelated records into a story. Classification discipline; the field is unchanged.
Same facility rule.
A chain must not end on a broad subsystem flag; leave the verb unset if nothing specific matches. Guidance.
verify_rule.py --coverage reports population per field. Tooling, no field change.
Placeholder padding GATED for entity fields -- confirm the source cannot supply the value before padding. Discipline, not a change.
Same padding gate.
Same padding gate.
Same padding gate.
The priv_lvl crosswalk was already documented and merely moved into the consolidated AAA table. No change.

banned.reason: Internal-only XCloud asset-inventory attribute (asset types such as t2.micro, gp3), not part of any event data model. Cortex REJECTS a MODEL rule that assigns it. Lint ERR-029.

mentioned_only.note: Named as the new home for a raw cloud service name displaced from the banned field. Unchanged.
Same -- an alternative home. Unchanged.
Still set only on a confident CLOUD_SERVICE_TYPE match, exactly as before.
A const-typed enum must be mapped over its COMPLETE set; a full 60-code crosswalk ships and WARN-048 flags a partial chain. Completeness of the MAPPING, not a change to the field.
Scratch temps moved to the tmp_ prefix because _ is reserved by the platform. Affects temporaries, not xdm fields.

meaning_changed.was: one label stamped across the whole feed
meaning_changed.now: decided PER RECORD from that record's own discriminators
meaning_changed.migration: This is the most consequential boundary in this bundle's history for anyone MEASURING the field. Before 1.7.0 it was constant per dataset by construction, so a constancy measurement taken against a pre-1.7.0 model proves nothing about a rule authored after it. Re-take any such measurement.

meaning_changed.was: one label stamped across the whole feed
meaning_changed.now: decided PER RECORD, drawn from the closed six-member EVENT_TAG enum, with an unrecognised record falling through to blank tags
meaning_changed.migration: Same as event.type: population and cardinality both change. A record matching no known kind now carries NO tag rather than a guessed one.

meaning_changed.now: carries the GOCORTEX_UNMODELLED sentinel on any record the rule cannot classify
meaning_changed.migration: A new reserved value enters the field's domain, so a distinct-value count or an equality filter crossing this version sees a value that did not exist before. It exists so a datamodel search never returns fewer rows than the raw dataset.

meaning_changed.was: the ROLE the system played in the authentication flow
meaning_changed.migration: THIS CHANGE WAS WRONG and 1.9.0 reverses it -- the field was always a role field, and the reasoning here (from the schema's plain String type to the absence of a vocabulary) was a non-sequitur. Recorded because a consumer crossing 1.6.1 in either direction still sees the values move, and because a bundle that hides its own reversals cannot be audited.
